The '''lesser houses''' were a group of families on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. Members of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]]&mdash;the six major [[Noble/Legends|noble]] families&mdash;met in the [[Great Assembly House/Legends|Great Assembly House]] to discuss matters of planetary importance with members of the lesser houses performing a purely advisory role.<ref name="AotE-HT2" />
